base.$description: Focus ring color for mouse/pointer focus. Uses accent-300 for brand-aligned focus indication. Theme-dependent.

accessible.$description: Focus ring color for keyboard focus (focus-visible). Uses accent-300 for brand-aligned focus indication. Theme-dependent.
